scope: Premeasurement source-derived accounting for the frozen capacity-only delta; not process RSS or timing.
method: 20 bytes per slot times capacity, plus unchanged Bloom bytes. Vector headers, allocator effects, other solver data, process RSS and sampled footprint are excluded from this arithmetic and are measured separately.
uncertainty: Equality of mathematical support is tested separately; changed traversal can change first-hit relation trajectories. More slots may reduce probe lengths but can increase allocation and scan costs; no direction or magnitude of runtime change is inferred.
